Title: Tasks, streams and review workflow

Description:
Add a Tasks system with Streams categorization and a `TaskLog` workflow for assignment, submission, review and verification. Include reviewers and points tracking.

Acceptance criteria:
- `Stream` and `Task` models to categorize and author tasks.
- `TaskLog` model tracking status, proof, reviewers, start/completion time and points.
- Endpoints for assigning tasks, submitting proof, and reviewers to verify.

Notes:
- This enables coordination for contributions and assignments within clubs.

Priority: Medium
